meta.title: Divan | Coffeehouse & Kitchen
meta.description: Divan is a coffeehouse in Isfahan pairing specialty coffee with the heritage of Persian ghahveh-khaneh culture and poetry.

hero.title: Divan
hero.subtitle: Every cup, a verse in our daily ledger
hero.description: At Divan, brewing coffee is treated like reading a ghazal — slow, precise, and full of meaning. Fresh-roasted beans, house-baked bread, and a room built for staying a while.

about_page.title: From an old house to a daily ledger
about_page.p1: Divan opened in 2022 inside one of Isfahan's old houses. The idea was simple: coffee at a world-class level, served in a room that still smells like home.
about_page.p2: The name "Divan" comes from classical Persian poetry collections — small moments gathered into a single volume. Every menu, every cup, every table is a page of that volume.
about_page.p3: We source beans from three regions — Ethiopia, Colombia, and Brazil — and roast weekly in our own glass-walled roastery.
